div.div:
Gaps (not drawn):
• Where do the Foundry model deployments process data? Foundry is drawn in West US 3 at Darrel's direction; the deployment type is an open question in the spine, and a Global Standard deployment processes outside the region.
• The resource group, container registry, Log Analytics workspace and Application Insights are listed in the spine's deployment section but in no AD, so they are not drawn.
• Private endpoints and VNet integration are deferred (AD-18): every data and AI service is on a public endpoint with managed identity only, and no network boundary is drawn.
• Subscription is not named in any source.
Each element's source is in grey under its name and in its tooltip.
